milestones.name: Rhea Platform Polish
milestones.goal: Clean up cross-cutting platform debt identified by the December 2025 consistency audit and prepare the homepage for multi-subflow workflows.

tasks.description: Refactor workflow cards to support multiple subflows: expandable card state, dynamic subflow detection from route structure, subflow metadata, responsive layout
tasks.notes: Blocks Metis Generator work (2ME.1). High priority.

tasks.description: Address all ARIA violations across workflow components
Eliminate validation duplication: refactor courseValidator.ts to wrap and call validateModuleXML() instead of reimplementing ~85 lines of module validation logic
tasks.notes: Effort: 2-3 hours. From consistency audit remediation.

tasks.description: Add schema documentation cross-references between metis/outputSchema.xml and courseSchema.xml explaining the embedding relationship
Add regression test suite verifying module generation consistency across Metis/Themis workflows (identical validation, schema structural equality, CI integration)
Update all Svelte legacy approaches and implementations to use Svelte 5 idioms throughout
Implement Themis-style Theia previews for Metis (and Metis-in-Themis)

milestones.name: Metis Form Workflow
milestones.goal: Replace the XML-upload requirement with a Themis-style guided form workflow, splitting Metis into a form-based Generator and a modernised XML Updater.

tasks.description: Build Metis Generator (/metis/generate): six-step form workflow (planning, objectives, project briefs, research topics, skills, review & generate), new form components, wired to the existing generation pipeline
tasks.notes: Architecture split: Generator (form-based, new) vs Updater (XML upload, existing).

tasks.description: Refactor Metis Updater (/metis/update) to accept single generated-module XML as primary input, with legacy 3-file upload as a fallback toggle; add module comparison/diff view
Add boilerplate module text insertion after generation
Ensure generated modules adhere to tech stack requirements
Allow preview sub-section toggling for module spec subsections (objectives, research topics/subtopics, project briefs/skills/examples), applied in both Metis and Metis-in-Themis
Implement the overview/full-generation split pattern (from Themis) in Metis
Allow granularity selection for module generation (separate booleans per section: project briefs, twists, research topics), with fill-in-missing-detail follow-up pass
Create session persistence: localStorage progress backup, restore-on-load confirmation, clear-session button

milestones.name: Themis Technical Debt
milestones.goal: Resolve known correctness and performance issues in the Themis module generation flow flagged during the October 2025 component refactor.

tasks.description: Fix SSE parsing vulnerability: JSON.parse(line.slice(6)) in ModuleGenerationList.svelte throws on malformed server JSON and can crash the generation flow
Fix race condition in SSE stream cleanup: reader removal from activeReaders in a finally block can conflict with onDestroy running concurrently
Fix missing error handling in generateAll: currently continues generating remaining modules after a critical failure instead of stopping

Redesign sequential module generation flow to reduce total wait time on large courses while preserving cross-module coherence (e.g. start module[x] once module[x-1]'s overview is ready, before its full detail completes)
Optimise ModuleGenerationList re-render: extract ModuleCard to a separate component or use keyed blocks so store updates don't re-render the full list on 20+ module courses

UX text and layout polish: bullet-list handling in CourseOverview, Phase 3 (Module Planning) and Phase 4 (Structure Review) text/layout, toggleable module previews, independent toggle state for siblings

milestones.name: Theia Upload & Export
milestones.goal: Complete the upload/resume round-trip for module XML and round out export format coverage.

tasks.description: Implement module XML upload & workflow resume: /theia upload interface, XML-to-store transformer, continue-in-Metis or preview/export actions, validation error handling
Add PDF export format (currently marked "coming soon" in UI)
Add export analytics/usage tracking
